notes.title: Bugs fixed, tutorial and storage
notes.content:
Bugs fixed, tutorial and storage cant go below 0.  A smoother and better gameplay.
If materials are below 0 it is automatically set to 0. New disadvantages fighting barbarians.

notes.title: Added Tutorial
notes.content: Small tutorial and Explanations added to the game. It will help you easier to understand how to start the game. An exploration of the game will be smoother.
